card.name: Inside valganciclovir and similar drug names
card.fires_on: Mostly the 'g' piece inside 'valganciclovir' in antiviral drug lists, and sometimes the end of drug names like talazoparib. Also fires occasionally on stray words such as 'a' or 'same' in ordinary web text.

modes.label: Valganciclovir spelling
modes.description: The 'g' after 'val' while the drug name valganciclovir is being spelled out in antiviral lists or dosing text.
modes.example: yclovir, adefovir dipivoxil, cidofovir, ganciclovir, valacyclovir, val<<g>>anciclovir, aminog

modes.label: End of kinase inhibitor names
modes.description: The final 'ib' piece of a drug name such as talazoparib in a list of interacting drugs.
modes.example: entrectinib, pemigatinib and talazopar<<ib>> prescribing information for dosing instructions if con

modes.label: Stray common words
modes.description: Scattered ordinary words in web text, such as 'a' before 'more descriptive' or 'same' in a linguistics passage.
modes.example: Make your links actually link to the page but add<< a>> more descriptive/informative title: Ask
